name: Horn
overview: The biblical symbol of the horn conveys strength, power, and divine exaltation, as seen in Psalms where the horn is associated with being anointed and exalted by God (Psalms 89:24; 92:10; 132:17). Figuratively and symbolically, horns also represent authority and protection, such as the horns of the altar and the anointing oil container. The prophetic visions in Daniel reveal horns as emblematic of political and spiritual powers, with the ten horns on a beast symbolizing formidable kingdoms and a notable 'little horn' signifying a prominent, speaking authority (Daniel 7:7-8). Thus, Scripture uses the horn both literally and figuratively to depict God's empowerment and sovereign rule.
